notes: Tier 2 cost $4,900 in Summer 2026 and Tier 3 cost $2,000 in Fall 2026. Summer 2027 Tier 2 applications are listed as coming soon. Email precollege@ucsd.edu with questions.
name: UC San Diego Marine Science Research Scholars
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies (with Scripps Institution of Oceanography mentors)
city: La Jolla, San Diego, CA (live online)
what_you_do: Take live online ocean science courses in three levels. Level 1 teaches marine biology. Level 2 is hands-on research with Scripps graduate students. Level 3 builds science writing and a chance to publish.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 who are at least 14 when the program starts. You finish one Tier 1 course before applying for Tier 2.
pay_detail: Tier 1 tuition is $1,500 for Winter 2027 and $2,000 for Spring 2027. Scholarships are listed but closed.
duration: Tier 1 live online: Winter 2027 runs Feb 16 to Mar 11, 2027. Spring 2027 runs Mar 29 to May 5, 2027.
deadline_text: Tier 1 applications are open. Winter 2027 closes Feb 8, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Spring 2027 closes Mar 22, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Space is limited and applications may close early.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Students are accepted on a rolling basis and hear back within 10 to 14 business days. Pay within 2 weeks of acceptance, or sooner if the course starts earlier.
